title: Scheduling
description: Plan who goes where and when — crews by the day, shifts by the hour, and project schedules — on boards shaped to how your company works.

empty.title: Set up your first board
empty.description: A board is a schedule for one part of your business: a crew booked by the day, a team on shifts, or your project schedules.
empty.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to create a schedule board in Setup.

grid.label: Schedule grid
grid.noPeople: No one is in this board's scope.
grid.selected: {count} cells selected — type to book them all, Delete to clear, Ctrl+D or Ctrl+R to fill
grid.hint: Click a cell and type a code to book. Drag across cells to book many at once; paste straight from a spreadsheet.
grid.readOnly: You can view this board. Booking needs permission to manage schedules.

picker.placeholder: Type a code, customer, project or location
picker.none: Nothing matches. Check the code or add the customer, project or schedule code first.
picker.hint: Add /detail or a time range like 6-14:30

history.clear: {count, plural, one {removing a booking} other {removing # bookings}}
history.paste: {count, plural, one {pasting a cell} other {pasting # cells}}
history.discard: {count, plural, one {discarding a change} other {discarding # changes}}

notices.skippedLeave: {count, plural, one {Skipped a day with recorded leave.} other {Skipped # days with recorded leave.}}
notices.skippedLeaveRemedy: Change the leave through its request if the person is working.
notices.copied: {count, plural, one {Copied a cell.} other {Copied # cells.}}
notices.unknownCodes: {count, plural, one {This code was not recognized: {codes}.} other {# codes were not recognized: {codes}.}}
notices.unknownCodesRemedy: Add them as schedule codes, customers or projects, then paste again.
notices.published: {count, plural, one {Published a change.} other {Published # changes.}}

publish.pending: {count, plural, one {# unpublished change} other {# unpublished changes}} for {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
publish.explain: People see these once you publish.

drawer.title: Booking
drawer.otherBoard: This booking belongs to {board}. Open that board to change it.
drawer.readOnly: You can view this booking. Changing it needs permission to manage schedules.
drawer.draft: This change is not published yet.
drawer.notesPlaceholder: What the crew needs to know

targets.empty: Nothing is booked in these dates yet.
targets.allBooked: Everyone is booked or on leave this day.

tasks.noProjects: No active projects are in this board's scope.

progress.noTasks: This project has no tasks yet. Add them on the Gantt or the project's work breakdown.
progress.explain: Earned hours are percent complete × budget hours. Productivity is earned ÷ actual hours: above 1.00 the work is ahead of budget. Hours to complete assume the pace so far continues. Actual hours count approved time.

newBoard.title: New board
newBoard.description: Pick the way this part of the business schedules. Everything stays adjustable in the board settings.

dispatch.title: Day dispatch
dispatch.description: Send people to a customer, site or job for the day. A two-week grid you type into; changes go out as you make them.

shifts.title: Shift roster
shifts.description: Part-day shifts by the hour, for stores, kitchens and front desks. Build the week, then publish it.

continuous.title: Round-the-clock operations
continuous.description: Day and night shifts that cross midnight, planned four weeks at a time for plants and around-the-clock teams.

projects.title: Project schedule
projects.description: Project tasks on a Gantt with dependencies and the critical path, plus production progress.

newBoard.name: Name
newBoard.afterwards: Booking hours, publishing and timesheet pre-fill can be changed in the board settings at any time.

errors.load: The schedule could not be loaded.
errors.save: The change could not be saved.
errors.publish: The board could not be published.
errors.search: The search could not be completed.

prefill.timesheetHint: Add the hours from your published bookings to empty days. Review them, then save.
prefill.crewHint: Add the people booked to this project on this day. Review the hours, then save the lines.
prefill.ticketHint: Add the crew booked to this project in the ticket period. Review the hours, then save.
prefill.nothing: Every scheduled day already has hours.
prefill.filled: {count, plural, one {Filled # day from the schedule.} other {Filled # days from the schedule.}} {skipped, plural, =0 {} one {# day already had hours.} other {# days already had hours.}} Review and save.
prefill.crewFilled: {count, plural, one {Added # person from the schedule.} other {Added # people from the schedule.}} Review the hours and save the lines.
prefill.crewNothing: Everyone booked to this project today is already on the sheet.
prefill.reload: Some scheduled people, tasks or time types changed. Close and reopen this ticket to load the current choices, then fill again.

notify.subject: Your schedule changed — {board}
notify.intro: Hi {name}, {count, plural, one {one day on your schedule changed.} other {# days on your schedule changed.}}
notify.footer: You receive this because {board} notifies people when their schedule changes.
notify.noTransport: Email is not set up, so people were notified in OpenBooks only. Set up email in Admin → Email.

mine.title: My schedule
mine.description: Where you are booked and when, as published by your schedulers.
mine.summary: {days, plural, one {# day booked} other {# days booked}} · {hours}
mine.empty: Nothing is booked for you from {from} to {through}.
